description: A synthetic four-faction sandbox containing every supported unit class and engine capability for regression and manual testing.

cities.name: Central Test City
cities.description: Neutral objective for influence and urban-area tests.

committee.public_briefing: Four fictional factions begin around a neutral objective with complete combined-arms test formations.
rules_of_engagement: This scenario is intended for feature testing rather than historical simulation.
Exercise movement, combat, support missions, diplomacy, directives, and persistence.

delegate_roles.briefing: Validate Red force controls and visibility.
Validate Blue force controls and visibility.
Validate Green force controls and visibility.
Validate Gold force controls and visibility.

victory_conditions: Testing succeeds when all required mechanics have been exercised without validation or runtime errors.
committee.staff_notes: Synthetic data: balance and historical realism are intentionally secondary to coverage.
